verdict.rationale: Omnara is an agent-hosting platform, so turning a plain-language request into a scoped implementation task is a fair question for it. The evidence only shows adjacent features: queuing an agent's next task, sending corrections, packaging skills and spawning subagents. Nothing documents converting a feature or bug description into a scoped task or spec.

support.subject: As a developer, I can describe a feature or bug in plain language and have it automatically turned into a scoped implementation task
